note: P4337 (Pro 28:28) — when the wicked rise, people hide; when they perish, the righteous increase.

dims.v: tyranny — the wicked in power, before whom people hide
the wicked whose rise to power drives people into hiding — tyranny that makes a whole society cower, until it perishes and the righteous can flourish
the righteous increase it is set against (266687)
set against the righteous who multiply when the wicked fall
rasha — 'when the WICKED rise, people hide themselves' (cf 28:12; 29:2); bad rulers make people cower. Their fall is a society's release. Who holds power shapes a whole people's freedom.
flourishing — the righteous multiplying when the wicked perish
the righteous who increase and flourish when the wicked perish — the good coming into their own once tyranny falls, a society breathing free again
the wicked's tyranny it is set against (266682)
set against the wicked whose rise made people hide
tsaddiq — 'but when they perish, the RIGHTEOUS increase'; the fall of the wicked lets the righteous flourish. Good multiplies where tyranny is removed.
